audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart marked Level 6 as Ryze and 2+ items as Ornn, the inverse of what the prose (whys[4], whys[6]) and the 57.55% win rate say. Level 1 was marked Ryze while both sides are non-committal.
audit.why: Ornn's R (Call of the Forge God, 140/120/100s) is a double knock-up on a champion with no dash; Ryze's only mobility is Realm Warp (180/160/140s), a delayed group portal, not a combat escape. Conversely Ryze is the scaler: Overload resets off W/E on a 5s base cooldown at 1000 range outrange Ornn's 450-range E entirely.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 6 Ornn, 2+ items Ryze — proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text talked about 'your forge prints item leads' and vaguely 'Ryze's ultimate changes the math', never stating what Realm Warp does.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a delayed teleport portal, not a dash or a fight-winning ult — it does not save Ryze from an R knock-up. Ryze's real spike is item-based (mana stacking), not level 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten to state the R catch vs a dashless Ryze; 2+ items rewritten to name the Overload-reset scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Rune Prison called it 'his point-blank root'. It is 615 range and it only roots if Spell Flux (E) is already on the target — otherwise it is a damage + slow.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' The decisive interaction of this lane is the E-then-W order, not W alone. Packet defect confirms no Ryze ability was ever named.
audit.corrected: Stated the Spell Flux prerequisite, the 615 range and the 11s rank-1 Rune Prison cooldown as the fight window; named Overload as the poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown breakdown listed no numbers at all.
audit.why: Rune Prison 11s at rank 1, Ornn E 14s at rank 1, Ornn R 140s at rank 1 — concrete numbers make the sequencing advice actionable.

edits.before: Weather the poke — brittle-proc him on the Rune Prison cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Rune Prison cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather Overload poke — Spell Flux (E) is what arms his root, so fight when Rune Prison is down: E into your own Q pillar, then Brittle.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither side can commit: you have no combo yet and he is a 615-range caster with no mana to spam Overload. Deny last-hits and take no risk.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God's double knock-up catches a dashless Ryze, and Realm Warp is a delayed portal, not an escape — his only out is Rune Prison plus kiting.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Ryze outscales you here: mana stacking plus Overload resets let him root and burst from 1000 range, well outside your 450-range E. Close early.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only if Spell Flux is on you — otherwise it just slows. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux; bare, it just slows. Its 11s cooldown is your window — W-brittle then E knockup.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, and it only roots if Spell Flux landed first — that pair is his entire setup. - Your E: 14s — never spend it without terrain in the line. - Your R: 140s — kill windows only.

notes: report[5].t 'before' in the brief reads '...sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.' — I copied it verbatim from currentText. Level chart was internally consistent between layers but contradicted its own whys text at Level 6 and 2+ items; flipped as one atomic pair-group. Ornn W (Bellows Breath) is flagged 'projectile' in the kit, which contradicts Riot's description of a cone of flame — treat the flag as tooltip-parse noise, and I asserted nothing about Wind Wall from it.
